6484.title: Inline-code-only selections take the Markdown clipboard path
6484.rootCauseOneLine: The clipboard serializer bypasses Markdown only for PRE selections, so inline-code-only copies acquire code-span delimiters.
6484.proposedFix: Copy raw text for selections wholly inside inline code, keeping Markdown for mixed selections and Add to chat through the shared serializer.
6484.caveats: Repeated in two trusted-main Linux/jsdom checkouts at the document copy-event boundary; native macOS release behavior was not directly tested. No provider, server, or runtime data was required.
